name: RINO Solutions Ex nR case iPad 10.2-inch
statusNote: Its IECEx certificate was cancelled in 2025.
summary: The RINO Solutions Ex nR case iPad 10.2-inch is a restricted-breathing (Ex nR) case for the iPad (9th generation) 10.2-inch, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. The tablet inside is a standard iPad (9th generation) 10.2-inch running iPadOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management. It has been discontinued.

iecex.marking: Ex nR IIC T4 Gc / Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc

certification.ambient: −20 °C to +40 °C (standard range: no Ta is marked on IECEx EXV 22.0019X, so IEC 60079-0 applies)

safety.conditions: Do not remove the SIM port plug or test port plug in the hazardous area. The equipment shall only be used in areas where there is a low risk of mechanical damage. Do not recharge in the hazardous area.
safety.peripherals: SIM port plug and test port plug stay in place in the hazardous area

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least September 2026 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 10.2-inch Retina IPS LCD, True Tone, fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating (no antireflective coating listed by Apple)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top (sleep/wake) button, volume buttons, Home button with Touch ID; no programmable hardware key

strengths: A standard iPad (9th generation) 10.2-inch inside, with the same apps and Apple device management
limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
Apple's minimum update period for this iPad has ended: for existing fleets only
